description: Governed entry point for the standalone Maryland licensed Child Care Center acquisition and offline normalization app.
redirect_policy: Fixed anonymous official Maryland ArcGIS item, layer and query URLs; redirects rejected and retained-input mode performs no network requests.
retry: No automatic source retry or job restart. Preserve completed acquisitions for explicit offline reuse.
checkpoint: Persist the app start, verified acquisition and normalization references, terminal receipt, independent replay, and atomically advance the governed pointer last.
idempotency: Immutable UUID-scoped app and child releases; retained inputs avoid repulling, historical releases are not overwritten, and failed runs leave the prior pointer unchanged.
cancellation: Abort transport and pacing, drain owned writers, retain completed child evidence, and require inspection for uncertain ownership.
retention_profile: Internal source candidates and immutable receipts. ZIP5 and ZIP4 remain separate; points are address-unverified; no business polygons or public record export.
